How to use the tracker

  1. Select a program on the left to view only that program, or choose All Programs.
  2. Update each requirement using the Status dropdown.
  3. Select the Document Type: Softcopy or Hardcopy.
  4. Enter the Date Received, Deadline, and Remarks as needed.
  5. Use Search, Category, and Status filters to locate records quickly.
  6. Your changes are automatically saved to the shared Supabase database. Use Save to manually sync all records.
  7. Use Export CSV to create an editable spreadsheet file, or Print to save a PDF.

Important: changes are stored in the shared Supabase database so authorized users can see the same tracker data across devices. Export the CSV regularly as a backup.

Tracker Instructions

This PACUCOA tracker contains 218 monitoring records (28 requirements for most programs; 22 for BSHM)., with a Document Type field for Softcopy or Hardcopy.

Document Type: Select whether the submitted/required document is a Softcopy or Hardcopy.

Status meaning: Not Started = no submission yet; In Progress = currently being prepared; Submitted = submitted to the responsible office; For Revision = returned for correction; Completed = final/complete.
